acceptance_criteria: The immutable POST-SUBTASK-172 run, dataset, feature, target, split, forecast, and model identities remain unchanged and are consumed only as pinned inputs and comparison evidence.

Only the exact POST-SUBTASK-176 target-game/team feature payload under identity b78d577d is joined, using canonical game and team IDs with exactly two team rows per eligible target game and no name-only mapping.

The replay preserves chronology: play/drive features are not used to fit 2010-2022 outcomes because their exact known-at time is May 2023; any learned augmentation for 2024 uses 2023 outcomes only and any 2025 evaluation uses 2023-2024 outcomes only.

Cold starts, null feature cells, 2011/2020 source-season absence, and the static 2023-2025 profile limitation remain explicit under versioned fit-only imputation and indicator rules; no factual value or timestamp is invented.

All datasets, models, predictions, metrics, and conclusions are independently identified PRELIMINARY_UNPROTECTED_PLAY_DRIVE_AUGMENTED and have no protected, champion, production, forecast-publication, A&M-lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or scientific authority.
An independent validator and isolated deterministic rebuild reproduce every accepted payload, model artifact, manifest, metric, and disposition byte-for-byte.
ai_context_notes: This is a superseding preliminary experiment, not a mutation of POST-SUBTASK-172.

The POST-SUBTASK-176 profile summarizes only exact 2010-2022 source evidence and is known before 2023-2025 target cutoffs, but it cannot be backcast as known before its May 2023 repository publication time.
No OpenAI output or model-generated fact may enter features, labels, splits, known-at time, fitting data, or acceptance.
definition_of_done: A new immutable external training-dataset identity joins the exact POST-SUBTASK-172 target/split population to the exact POST-SUBTASK-176 play/drive development-PIT feature identity without rewriting either input.

The complete low-cost baseline/replay pipeline runs with explicit chronological eligibility, fit-only imputation, cold-start handling, serialization, prediction replay, calibration diagnostics, metrics by season and relevant slice, and provenance verification.

The experiment reports whether the added features improve, degrade, or cannot yet support each model family; null or negative results are preserved and no empirical threshold is changed to force adoption.
All external payloads pass schema, identity, chronology, PIT, target-leakage, deterministic replay, and byte-identity validation, and reconstructible staging output is cleaned.
Protected promotion remains closed and Lane A approximately 2010-2025 historical expansion continues independently.
end_to_end_validation: Re-read the exact POST-SUBTASK-172 manifest and payloads plus the exact POST-SUBTASK-176 manifest and feature payload; rebuild the joined game-level matrix, chronological online assignments, imputation state, model artifacts, predictions, calibration and metrics; verify hashes, target exclusion, source known-at eligibility, serialization, replay equality, and protected closure; then remove the reconstructible rebuild.
in_scope: Exact canonical-ID game/team join for the 2023-2025 POST-SUBTASK-176 feature population.
Chronological online learning and evaluation that never backcasts the May 2023 feature publication time.
Low-cost simple baseline comparison, calibration diagnostics, artifact serialization, replay, provenance, and negative-result preservation.
objective: Replay the preliminary model pipeline with the exact POST-SUBTASK-176 play/drive development-PIT features without mutating POST-SUBTASK-172 or opening protected promotion.
out_of_scope: Backcasting POST-SUBTASK-176 features into 2010-2022 training rows or fabricating an earlier known-at timestamp.
Changing the immutable POST-SUBTASK-172 datasets, models, predictions, splits, metrics, or conclusions.
Protected evaluation, champion or production promotion, forecast publication, A&M specialization lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or any scientific claim.

POST-SUBTASK-176 exact development-only PIT play/drive feature identity and independent validation.

Rows, games, seasons, feature counts, cold starts, missingness, exclusions, chronological cutoffs, training windows, leakage checks, and metrics by season/slice.

risk_failure_conditions: Any POST-SUBTASK-176 feature is represented as known before its exact source publication time or is used to fit an earlier target outcome.
Any target outcome, target-game event, future row, name-only identity mapping, or fabricated value enters the feature matrix.
Any result is represented as protected, champion, production, forecast-publication, A&M-lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or scientific authority.
scope: Build and independently validate one separately lineaged preliminary-unprotected replay using only the exact POST-SUBTASK-176 development-PIT feature population at its defensible known-at horizon.
stop_conditions: Stop the affected artifact on input hash, game/team identity, chronology, target overlap, schema, missingness, model serialization, prediction replay, metric, or deterministic rebuild failure.
Quarantine only affected rows or model families and continue independently valid historical acquisition and baseline work.
Do not weaken splits, chronology, imputation, validation, or scientific gates merely to obtain apparent improvement.
title: Replay preliminary baselines with play/drive development-PIT features
why_this_exists: The exact POST-SUBTASK-176 features are eligible for preliminary research but cannot be silently inserted into the older fixed baseline. A separately identified chronological replay is required to measure their value honestly and exercise the full pipeline without protected overclaim.
